item.title: Hidden immune organ in skull may help fight brain cancer
item.description: Scientists found a hidden immune organ inside the skull that acts as a rapid first responder against brain cancer in mice. Strengthening it may help.

item.title: New Horizons finds signs of liquid nitrogen on Pluto
item.description: Scientists have found the first evidence that liquid may have flowed across Pluto's surface recently, based on dark features on Sputnik Planitia.
